LESSON: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Modes of preservation of the Qur’an

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Modes of preservation of the Qur’an
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
2. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity

▸ Skill 2: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
• Model 2: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
2. Practise: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to preserve the Qur’an?
2. How is the Qur’an preserved in modern times?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
• recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it
